description: reference_only rendering contributes +0.5 to advisory_score only; does not enter pd_only_gap calculation (R5 fix)

triggering.notes: When a rendering has role=reference_only, its advisory bonus (+0.5) goes to advisory_score field only. pd_only_gap uses anchor_pd_score - attestor_pd_score = 4.0 - 0.0 = 4.0; the +0.5 advisory never enters this calculation, preventing reference_only from tipping the auto-choice gap (R5 closure).

near_miss.near_miss_reason: pd_attestor role contributes its base score 3.0 to the pd_only_gap directly; advisory_score remains 0.0. modifier_fires=false means the ADVISORY-specific +0.5 path is not taken.
